description: A script that generates a diff between two IDL JSON files, comparing interface definitions and annotating differences.

methods.name: load_json_file
methods.description: Loads a JSON file into a Python dictionary.

methods.name: members_diff
methods.description: Creates a diff between two interface objects by annotating added or deleted members.

methods.name: annotate_all_members
methods.description: Adds a diff annotation to all members of an interface.

methods.name: interfaces_diff
methods.description: Compares two sets of interfaces and produces a diff with annotations.

methods.name: write_diff
methods.description: Writes the diff dictionary to a JSON file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads input files, computes diff, and writes output.
